scenarios.initialPrompt: 我要拍一个 9 秒短片：凌晨自助洗衣店，女孩把一枚旧纽扣放进玻璃罐，滚筒停下时罐里映出星空。整理成 3 个镜头。先只整理草案，不生成参考，不提交视频。
scenarios.revisionPrompt: 第二个镜头不要拍女孩正面，改成玻璃罐和旧纽扣的近景；第三个镜头只保留星空倒影，不要重复第二个镜头。先形成修改确认，不要保存，不生成素材。
beforeFix: Multiple target clauses were merged into one shot revision.
Generic replacement language could be mislabeled as a scene move.
Workflow and repetition-control clauses leaked into shot content.

afterFix.shot2: 玻璃罐和旧纽扣的近景

scenarios.prompt: 我想拍一个克制、安静的 8 秒短片：夜班护士在医院天台听到坏掉收音机里传来海浪声，最后她笑了一下。你来决定最少需要几个镜头。先只讨论和整理，不生成任何素材。
beforeFix: The negative material boundary was routed to material workspace review.
The meta planning instruction became a storyboard shot.

afterFix.shot1: 夜班护士在医院天台听到坏掉收音机里传来海浪声

residualObservations.finding: The initial deterministic three-shot fallback repeats the ending before creator revision.
Character extraction can list both 护士 and 夜班护士 for one role.
This was operator-observed packaged acceptance, not external creator usability research.
